WITH per_product AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
  FROM Products AS p
  JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(item_count) AS total_item_count
  FROM per_product
),
per_type AS (
  SELECT
    pp.product_type_description,
    AVG(pp.avg_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
    AVG(pp.item_count) AS avg_item_count,
    AVG(1.0 * pp.item_count / NULLIF(t.total_item_count, 0)) AS avg_item_share
  FROM per_product AS pp
  CROSS JOIN totals AS t
  GROUP BY pp.product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_product_quantity),
  AVG(avg_item_count),
  AVG(avg_item_share)
FROM per_type
